title: Rapid Detection of Chemical Constituents of Capsicum chinense (Chile Habanero) and Capsicum pubescens (Chile Manzano) Extracts Obtained from Maceration and Ultrasonic Bath Extraction Methods
content: The demand for sustainable and organic products is increasing, and it is crucial to identify and extract their chemical compounds in a precise manner to ensure their effectiveness. Chili peppers are a staple ingredient in Mexican cuisine, and Mexico has the most diverse genetic variety of Capsicum [1]. Among the great diversity of the Capsicum genus, Capsicum chinense (Chile Habanero) and Capsicum pubescens (Chile Manzano) are examples of the Capsicum genus known for their high capsaicin content [2], which has vast applications in various industries. Capsaicinoids are plant secondary metabolites. The main pungent capsaicinoid is capsaicin. Capsaicin is a group of compounds that can be found in chili peppers from the Capsicum genus of the Solanaceae family. These compounds are responsible for flavoring, coloring, and preserving food, as well contribute to the pharmacological properties of the fruits [3].
